theory.title: Exercise 4.3.2: Add Time To Date
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "Operations take time. Cooldowns, warmups, delays. Add Time To Date calculates when future events will occur based on current time plus duration."

Add Time To Date

Calculate future timestamps:

Library    DateTime

${now}=    Get Current Date    result_format=%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S

${in_2_hours}=    Add Time To Date    ${now}    2 hours
# Current + 2 hours

${tomorrow}=    Add Time To Date    ${now}    1 day
# Current + 24 hours

${complex}=    Add Time To Date    ${now}    1 hour 30 minutes 45 seconds
# Multiple units

Time Units:

  • seconds or s
  • minutes or min
  • hours or h
  • days or d
  • weeks or w

Example: Timeout Calculation

*** Settings ***
Library    DateTime

*** Test Cases ***
Calculate Timeout
    ${start}=    Get Current Date
    ${timeout}=    Add Time To Date    ${start}    5 minutes
    Log    Operation must complete by: ${timeout}
    
    # ... operation ...
    
    ${end}=    Get Current Date
    ${exceeded}=    Subtract Date From Date    ${end}    ${timeout}
    IF    ${exceeded} > 0
        Fail    Operation exceeded timeout!
    END

⚠️ Add Time To Date Tips

  • Returns new date (doesn't modify original)
  • Can combine multiple units
  • Works with any date format
  • Use for: scheduling, timeouts, deadlines
  • Negative values allowed: Add Time To Date ${now} -1 hour (goes backward)
